items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: because I think Daddy O’ discovered Ramsey

ctx.x: Sid McCoy. He had a show called… …he was one of the great jazz DJs in Chicago, called, "The Real McCoy" and he had his theme song was, "The Real McCoy" by Frank Sinatra and then he'd come on. He had this smooth voice and he'd say, "Hey, hey, Old Bean, and you too baby! It's the Real McCoy!" He used to come and hear me and Daddy O' used to come and hear me, because I think Daddy O’ discovered Ramsey...
